study: Capsule Review — sparse-reference annotation-run coverage ceiling and nonblood workload audit
interpretation: Post-hoc descriptive audit of already inspected Galar examinations. This is NOT blinded preregistration or clinical event/lesion sensitivity.
scientific_question: At fixed budgets, does a ranking hit distinct stretches of blood-positive source annotations, or repeatedly select images from the same stretch? Even at 100% review of the saved 512 reference images, how many of the original source's annotated positive stretches are unrepresented?

data_source.corrected_labels_zip: Official Galar v2 December 2025 corrected labels (Le Floch et al.; CC BY 4.0), file ID 60383963

reference_image_score_sources.role: historical development; used for original model checkpoint selection; not independent
exam-selected fitting-candidate transfer; original checkpoint scores only

data_source.image_scores: Previously saved and source-image verified original CNN predictions; for exams 25/27/29 also fixed original-only and expanded continued checkpoint scores, no new inference.
data_source.reference_cohort: 512 uniform label-blind preselected source-image positions per examination (NOT enriched-only frames), checked for duplicates and equality with corrected source blood label and original frame IDs

run_definition.positive_label: Exactly blood=1; blood=0 does not mean clinically normal, unknown is not negative
run_definition.source_order: Original corrected official label rows in ascending numeric frame
run_definition.adjacency: Two blood-positive rows share a source annotation run iff consecutive in the corrected CSV and original source frame indices differ by exactly 5. Break on 0/blank and on missing/gapped source rows. Check modal nonlabel stride 5 with >95% support on allowed exams before using this rule.
run_definition.units: Contiguous positive annotation runs. NOT independently adjudicated lesions, pathology events or full contiguous video.

comparison.measured_on: Only each examination's fixed 512-reference population; enriched-only images excluded completely
comparison.k_rule: floor(512*budget_percent/100) selected images for all methods
comparison.rank_ties: descending exact saved score then ascending source frame index
comparison.uniform_positions: For j=0..k-1, floor((2*j+1)*512/(2*k)) in ascending source-frame order
comparison.methods: Original compact blood CNN, unchanged original fixed red-excess comparator, uniform sampling. Original-only and expanded continued CNNs only on examination IDs 25, 27 and 29, which were held out from those continued models' fitting.
comparison.primary_outcomes: For each exam/method/budget, number of FULL ORIGINAL-ANNOTATION blood-positive runs intersected by >=1 selected reference image, total source positive runs, run recall or null when no source-positive runs, and reference-only 100%-review ceiling.
comparison.secondary_outcomes: Number of selected sampled frames with blood=1 versus blood=0, source-run coverage by fixed run-size strata, count of distinct blood-positive original source positions in the 512 reference cohort.
comparison.negative_exam_audit: For source annotation blood-negative exam 9 report number of reference frames selected per budget and uncalibrated original CNN-score count above 0.1, 0.5, 0.9. These are NOT diagnostic false positives or calibrated operating thresholds.
comparison.zero_positive_exams: Source-positive-run recall undefined/null, not 0% or 100%. Keep selected-image workload.
comparison.selection_policy: No new model selection, fitting, score modification, optimization, source-pixel access, or reassignment of protected examination roles after seeing run outcomes. Report every exam, every run-length stratum and every fixed budget.

limits: The 512 reference images are themselves sparse; the 100% ceiling refers to inspecting all 512 sampled reference images, not the full examination.
Original source may include more images than the corrected-labelled positions; only annotated source rows are represented in run denominators.
Missing true clinical lesion identity, patient identity, capture times and complete video sequence.
Several original models were previously selected using historical 9–10; earlier outcomes for other examinations already inspected, so no independent generalization claims.
Exam 9 has no source blood annotation positives, but may contain other pathology; do not call every selection a false clinical diagnosis.
Review-budget percentages are experiment operating points, not product constraints.
private_data: Original score rows and source frame IDs remain in private Capsule Review Library. Git may contain only the protocol, verified code, synthetic tests, and nonidentifying aggregate examination-level counts.
